description: This file declares abstract classes related to providing and consuming kernel log pipes within the cuttlefish project. It defines the KernelLogPipeProvider interface for classes that supply kernel log pipes and a marker class KernelLogPipeConsumer.

classes.name: KernelLogPipeProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that defines an interface for providing a kernel log pipe, inheriting from SetupFeature.

classes.name: KernelLogPipeConsumer
classes.description: A marker class to identify classes that inject KernelLogPipe.

methods.name: KernelLogPipeProvider::~KernelLogPipeProvider
methods.description: Default destructor for the KernelLogPipeProvider interface.

methods.name: KernelLogPipeProvider::KernelLogPipe
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the kernel log pipe.
